segments.title: The sidebar player opens up on hover
segments.body: A video plays in a background tab. Click its pause straight away: it pauses. Then point at the player and rest. 0.2.43-nightly.7 grows it into a full player: artist, seek bar with time played and total, previous, play/pause and next, mute, Picture in Picture and close, and play/pause moves to the middle, so the pointer is now on Picture in Picture. 0.2.43-nightly.6 only showed close and mute beside the play button.

segments.title: Glass on the tiles and Downloads, an even divider
segments.body: Point at a pinned tile, then open Downloads, in dark mode. 0.2.43-nightly.7 puts the liquid glass back on the pinned tiles and the Downloads panel, and the dashed divider under the tiles has the same space above as below. 0.2.43-nightly.6 drew them flat, with twice the space above the divider.
